title.value: NL-PS-L1-A - Level 1a: Minimal metadata and empty sections - Patient id query

description.value: The serving system provides an NL-PS for its level 1a test patient, in which all mandatory sections are empty, with an emptyReason and a narrative. Conformancelab searches the Patient Summary of the Patient id you enter at test setup. Enter the id of your level 1a test patient, without 'Patient/'. Implementation Guides: NL-PS https://ig.nictiz.nl/nlps/ and generic building blocks (GBB) https://ig.nictiz.nl/gbb/
